تكتروا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَرُوا (taktarū) /tak.ta.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# تُكْتَرَوْا (tuktaraw) /tuk.ta.raw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
